Dear Tokoriwa, Please excuse my message.

My name is Omochi Hatsunagi, who previously requested an illustration from Skeb.
Thank you very much! I like your illustration very much!

I would like to ask you to draw an illustration of Omochi Hatsunagi with a new model and new clothes.

Please contact us at https://x.com/hatsunagiomochi/status/1892884567360754177?s=46&t=kgaXb8mDfay14YAkJyGdeA

About the illustration
Please feel free to draw any composition, pose, facial expression, etc.
 We would like to have a transparent layer of only the character for use as a thumbnail.
We would appreciate it if you could draw the head, ears, and the sides of the hair so that they are not cut off.

Character Information
Droopy eyes
Breasts are large
Age is about 20s
Height 158cm (164cm including heels)

Usage
Vtuber activity, thumbnail for distribution, use on SNS

Thank you very much for your consideration!

https://x.com/hatsunagiomochi/status/1892884567360754177?s=46&t=kgaXb8mDfay14YAkJyGdeA

Hello again! I hope you have been well! Please refer to my character sheet + pose in the reference URL below!

Specific details:
-Emotionless, no smiling
-Body size is similar to that of Xiao from Genshin Impact. Slightly small to medium sized body.
-Background is optional. White or no background is good too.

-If you could, please use the standing pose as seen in the ref image!
-Coat on, but it is only worn over the shoulders. Arms are not in the sleeves.
-Glasses on!
-Earring on!
-Mask on!
-Left hand in pocket
-Right hand holding throwing needles, which are made of ice. Held in between his fingers.

Other:
-I would like to use your artwork in my YouTube videos, if you would allow it. I do not monetize my videos.
-Would it also be okay to have a transparent background and non-signature copy? PSD would be best.

Please reject this request if you are not comfortable with me using your art in my videos or do not like any of these conditions. Thank you very much!

https://imgur.com/a/XGulwET

Dear Tokoriwa, Please excuse my message.
My name is Nagi Tomanagi.

I have been looking at Tokorinowa-sama's wonderful illustrations for a long time and have been thinking of commissioning you to do one someday!
Could you please draw an illustration of my self-incarnated Vtuber Hatsunagi Omochi (@HatsunagiOmochi)?

▼Materials
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18rsVzCtSeVNlDYZgZd7BHK-2DtcuYVOD?usp=sharing

About the illustration
We do not specify the composition or situation of the illustration. We would like you to draw freely.
We would like to have a transparent layer of the character only, as we would like to use it as a thumbnail.
 We would appreciate it if you could draw the head, ears, and the sides of the hair so that they are not cut off.

Purpose of use
Vtuber activities, thumbnails for distribution, use on SNS

 Thank you very much for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18rsVzCtSeVNlDYZgZd7BHK-2DtcuYVOD?usp=sharing

Nice to meet you! I was attracted by your beautiful illustrations and sent a request to you to draw Kelsey of Ark Knights.  I would be happy if you could draw her during break time, leaving the expression up to me.  I would appreciate it if you would consider my request...!

Hello! I have updated my character sheet with a new design!

Details:
-Emotionless is best, but slightly annoyed is okay. No smiling this time.
-Body size and attitude is similar to that of Xiao from Genshin Impact. Slightly small to medium sized body.
-Background is optional. White or no background is good too.
-You can include the magic orb if you want or if you think it will help with the pose. It is 50% magic and 50% ice with a white magnolia flower inside.
-Body pose is up to you. Please do something that has a similar, cool feel to the other sample commissions on the example sheet! (If you have trouble deciding, then you may also consider cool poses that girls might do.)

With this new design, please do the following:
-Coat on
-Glasses on
-Earring on
-Mask off

Other:
-I would like to use your artwork in my YouTube videos, if you would allow it. I do not monetize my videos.
-Would it also be okay to have a transparent and non-signature copy? PSD would be best.

Thank you!

https://imgur.com/a/Fey8arL

Hello.
Thank you for the wonderful illustration before!

I would like to ask you to illustrate Kohana Koromo Shii (https://twitter.com/kohanaisii) again!
As for her outfit, I would like her to be tailored in a swimsuit instead of the usual nurse's uniform or plain clothes, and I would like her to be drawn in a summery atmosphere to match the outfit.
I would like to have the illustration drawn in a summery atmosphere to match the outfit!

The design of the swimsuit, pose, facial expressions, etc. are up to you!
The location can be anywhere, such as a river, a swimming pool, or a seaside café.

For reference, this is a costume in a nurse's uniform.
(https://twitter.com/kohanaisii/status/1209771624947314689)

Thank you in advance!

Hi, I really like your artworks, they are so pretty! If possible, I want to request for my original character. 

He is a lively boy lived near snowy mountains in a nomadic life mode. He has white fluffy tail and his skin is a light-brown color.  

Could you draw him in his "2 現代服" outfit?  The pose and composition is up to you! Unique layout and dynamic scene is welcomed❤️

Also, could you leave me a version of the character with transparent background if possible? Thank you so much!

My name is Ibaramuanto and I am an individual VTuber.

Hello, I would like to request an artwork of Holo from Spice and Wolf! If possible, I would like for her to be drawn in an SNS style, like your Daitaku Helios illustration. Another style is ok too, but I want her to look happy and full of energy. Also, please give her any outfit of your choosing! A classic style from her light novel or a new, stylish original outfit are both ok!!! A background would be amazing, but you don't have to make it too fancy, simple is ok!
This illustration will be for a friend's birthday, so you can include some birthday themes too if you would like! (other themes are ok too!!!) If possible, I would like to have a version of the illustration signed by you and one unsigned. 
Thank you so much in advance!!! ^_^
